sentences.en: Many astronomers assume that the universe continues to expand forever.
sentences.zh: 许多天文学家认为宇宙将会永远膨胀下去。

sentences.en: He assumed that the man was hiding something from him.
sentences.zh: 他假定那个人有什么事情瞒着他。

sentences.en: I assume that it was all they wanted to say.
sentences.zh: 我假设这就是他们想说的所有内容。

senses.zh: 僭取；篡夺；夺取；擅用；侵占

mnemonic: 词根记忆：as（表加强）+sum（拿，取） +e→预先拿取→假定，设想
